name: 01_native_single_tsql
description: One agent-written T-SQL query, wrapped as a complete result with an inferred descriptor.

queries.text: SELECT TOP 10 c.region, SUM(f.net_amount) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 'FY27-Q1' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC
